VFT-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProfileCard component and its CSS. It has a bordered container (use a border-width token), a title, a subtitle, and a skeleton variant with two shimmer bars (one full-width, one narrower — use a size token for the shorter bar width). Use @layer components for the CSS. Every visual value must come from a --shelf-* token (assume tokens exist for border-width, colors, spacing, sizes). Include the CSS file.
VFT-01.output:
The file is written at `src/components/ProfileCard/ProfileCard.css`. Key decisions:

- All visual values use `--shelf-*` tokens (border-width, colors, spacing, font sizes, sizes, animation duration/easing/opacity).
- `@keyframes shimmer` is declared **inside** `@layer components`, satisfying the keyframes-in-layer constraint.
- Skeleton bars animate only `opacity` (no transform/color), per the animate-only-transform-and-opacity constraint.
- Two skeleton bar modifier classes: `--full` (100% width) and `--narrow` (size token for shorter bar).
- Class names are kebab-case throughout.
- No raw hex, px, rem, %, or keyword color values — all deferred to tokens.
